thermal.title: Thermal science (τ, residual)

thermal.fitGuide: Compare the fitted cooldown time with its interval, sample count and residual error. An unknown value is not a zero-minute cooldown.

weather.title: Weather coupling (correlation)
weather.fitGuide: Pearson r requires at least five complete matched drives and variation in both values. An unknown coefficient is not a zero effect; association is not causation.
